data.description: Axiom Compute Corp is a synthetic issuer used in Parallax fixture tests. It does not exist. Every value in this fixture is produced by gen_mock_fixtures.py from a pinned seed, so the file can be regenerated and compared byte for byte.
data.name: Axiom Compute Corp

field_notes.close: latest close; no price date is returned.
field_notes.market_cap: market cap in the currency given by `currency`, for this listing line only; for multi-class issuers it is not the company total.
field_notes.shares_outstanding: share count for this listing line.

score_scale.cadence: Scores are a weekly ranking; prices update daily. Every factor is as of the ranking date and does not reflect later price moves.
score_scale.more: Ask what a factor measures or why a score changed; the methodology lookup costs nothing extra on this call.
score_scale.range: 0-10. Each per-stock score is a percentile rank against other covered stocks, not an absolute measure.
score_scale.weighting: The overall score's factor weights shift across market regimes, so one factor can dominate `total` in a way a plain average would not.
